title: Cascade Vision New-Wearer Allowance for Stand-Alone Fittings
content:
A new-wearer allowance is added to a Vision Plans stand-alone fitting when the patient has no recent fitting under the same provider agreement. The fittings looked at are the latest standard contact-lens fitting and the latest specialty contact-lens fitting of the patient under that agreement whose remark is paid or out-of-network reimbursement paid, each kind read on its own. The allowance applies when neither is dated before the fitting and less than thirty-six whole calendar months (36) before it.

| Channel | New wearer (no such fitting within 36 whole months before) | Returning wearer |
|---|---|---|
| Participating independent practice | 15.00 | None |
| Participating retail-chain location | 10.00 | None |
| Out of network | None | None |

**Counting details.**
- A month is complete on the same day number.
- When the latest fitting of a kind is the only such service on its date and has been reversed, there is taken to be none of that kind and no earlier one is looked at. Of several on that date, a reversal of one leaves that date standing.
- A fitting dated on the same day as this fitting is not "before" it.

**Boundary (hypothetical dates).** The latest paid standard fitting under the agreement was 30 April. A stand-alone fitting on 29 April three years later is 35 whole months later: a returning wearer, no allowance. On 30 April three years later it is 36 whole months later: 15.00 at an independent practice, 10.00 at a retail-chain location.
